description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for handling incoming commands in a gateway service, including default and maximum timeout values, with an internal enum specifying known configuration paths and default values.

classes.name: CommandConfig
classes.description: Immutable interface providing method signatures for command timeout configurations.

classes.name: CommandConfig.CommandConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration implementing KnownConfigValue that defines specific configuration keys and default values for command timeouts.

methods.name: getDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Returns the default timeout duration for a command.

methods.name: getMaxTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum timeout duration for a command.
